title: 第17章 奖励第18章 一剑击败
content_zh:
“不知道主持本届万象天才战的是万象殿哪位长老？”
“想必已经在来的路上！
大家快看，柳家柳若雪过来了！”
“嘶！
几个月不见，柳若雪更加美艳动人了！
不愧是四品水属性武魂的天才，身上时时刻刻散发着水属性气息……”
“笑话，就凭你还能感觉到柳小姐身上的水属性气息？”
……
天水城，演武场内，一片嘈杂声。
随着柳方志、柳若雪以及柳狂等人走进演武场，顿时众人兴奋之色更浓，议论声更大。
如今的柳若雪，可谓天水城风云人物。
“听说此次柳若雪返回天水城，还有两名万象殿外殿弟子护送，想必她身边那两位，便是外殿的天才！”
有人兴奋说道。
只见在柳若雪身旁，赫然一左一右站着两人。
这两人，正是雷震安排保护柳若雪的外殿弟子，男子名叫杨本洪，女子则叫岳依琳，其中，岳依琳是淬体境九重后期，杨本洪更是半只脚踏入通脉境，早就达到了淬体境九重巅峰。
如此修为，在外殿当中，亦是佼佼者！
就在这时，一道身影正好也走进演武场，秦浩提着铁剑，面色平静，缓步而来。
“秦浩？！”
秦浩刚刚出现，顿时便吸引了柳若雪、柳狂、柳若杰等人注意。
柳若雪秀眉一蹙，眼中闪过一抹厌恶。

“秦浩，你这个废物还敢出现！”
柳狂则是勃然大怒，若非自己需要闭关提升修为，他早就杀上秦家，找秦浩麻烦了。
柳若杰满眼怨毒之色，上次被秦浩当众打脸，抢走丹药，如今他都快成天水城笑话了！
柳若雪美目一扫，淡淡道：“秦浩，我知道你心中不甘，但我没想到，你得知我回天水城，竟然追到这里来了！
我柳若雪心中的白马王子，是雷震那样的绝世天才，而非你这种废物！
我们不是一个世界的人，另外，这万象天才战，更不是你该来的地方，自己滚出去吧！”
听到这话，秦浩笑了，他语气平静，讥讽道：“柳若雪，你未免太过自信了一点，我来不来，跟你有什么关系，还有，你说的没错，像你这种趋炎附势，忘恩负义之人，确实和我不是一个世界的。”
柳若雪脸色一沉，变得有些难看起来，正要说话，这时，柳若雪身旁，一脸傲然的杨本洪，忽然沉声道：
“你就是秦浩？”
杨本洪上下打量，用一种高高在上的语气说道：“早听闻柳师妹在天水城被人追求，原来就是你！
呵呵，柳师妹天赋卓绝，美艳动人，你也不照照镜子，看看自己配不配得上柳师妹。”
“而且，我万象殿，不可能招收你这种天赋垃圾，人品也垃圾的人，滚吧！”
杨本洪的话一出，顿时许多柳家子弟纷纷目露戏谑起来，同样的话，换做万象殿弟子来说，那意义就不一样了。
“你是哪根葱？我天水城天才战，关你什么事？”
秦浩斜视杨本洪，丝毫没有给他面子。
这里的动静，也引起了观众台不少人注意。
看到秦浩竟然跟万象殿弟子吵起来了，周围顿时一片哗然。
“大胆，你大胆，你知道我是什么人吗？”
杨本洪大怒，猛地上前一步，怒视秦浩。
content_en:
"I wonder which elder of the Wanxiang Hall is presiding over this Wanxiang Genius Competition?"
“I must be on the way here already!
Look, everyone, Liu Ruoxue from the Liu family is here! "
"Hiss!
After not seeing each other for a few months, Liu Ruoxue is even more beautiful!
He is worthy of being a genius with a fourth-grade water-attribute martial spirit, and his body exudes a water-attribute aura all the time..."
"What a joke, just because you can still feel the water-attribute aura on Miss Liu's body?"
…
In Tianshui City, there was a lot of noise in the martial arts arena.
As Liu Fangzhi, Liu Ruoxue, Liu Kuang and others entered the martial arts arena, everyone suddenly became more excited and talked louder.
Today's Liu Ruoxue can be said to be a man of the hour in Tianshui City.
"I heard that this time Liu Ruoxue returned to Tianshui City, she was escorted by two disciples from the outer hall of the Wanxiang Hall. I think those two beside her are the geniuses of the outer hall!"
someone said excitedly.
I saw two people standing on the left and right next to Liu Ruoxue.
These two people were the disciples of the outer palace arranged by Lei Zhen to protect Liu Ruoxue. The man was named Yang Benhong, and the woman was named Yue Yilin. Among them, Yue Yilin was at the late stage of the ninth level of the Body Tempering Realm, and Yang Benhong had even half-stepped into the Tongmai Realm, having already reached the peak of the ninth level of the Body Tempering Realm.
With such a cultivation level, he is also the best among the outer halls!
At this moment, a figure walked into the martial arts arena. Qin Hao came slowly with an iron sword in hand and a calm expression on his face.
"Qin Hao?!"
As soon as Qin Hao appeared, he immediately attracted the attention of Liu Ruoxue, Liu Kuang, Liu Ruojie and others.
Liu Ruoxue frowned, a trace of disgust flashing in her eyes.
"Qin Hao, how dare you, a loser, show up!"
Liu Kuang was furious. If he hadn't needed to retreat to improve his cultivation, he would have killed the Qin family and caused trouble for Qin Hao.
Liu Ruojie's eyes were full of resentment. Last time he was slapped in the face by Qin Hao in public and took the pill away. Now he is almost becoming a joke in Tianshui City!
Liu Ruoxue swept her beautiful eyes and said calmly: "Qin Hao, I know you are unwilling, but I didn't expect that you would chase me here after learning that I was returning to Tianshui City!
The prince charming in my heart, Liu Ruoxue, is a peerless genius like Lei Zhen, not a waste like you!
We are not from the same world. Besides, this war of all things genius is not where you should be. Get out! "
Hearing this, Qin Hao smiled. His tone was calm and he said sarcastically: "Liu Ruoxue, you are a little too confident. Whether I come or not has nothing to do with you. Also, you are right. People like you who follow the crowd and are ungrateful are indeed from the same world as me."
Liu Ruoxue's face darkened and became a little ugly. She was about to speak. At this time, beside Liu Ruoxue, Yang Benhong, who looked proud, suddenly said in a deep voice:
"Are you Qin Hao?"
Yang Benhong looked up and down and said in a condescending tone: "I heard that Junior Sister Liu was being pursued in Tianshui City, so it was you!
Haha, Junior Sister Liu is extremely talented and beautiful, but you don’t even look in the mirror to see if you are worthy of Junior Sister Liu. "
"Besides, it is impossible for me, the Wanxiang Palace, to recruit someone with rubbish talent and rubbish character like you, so get out!"
As soon as Yang Benhong's words came out, many Liu family disciples suddenly looked at each other and started joking. The same words would have a different meaning to the disciples of Wanxiang Hall.
"Who are you? What does my Tianshui City genius battle have to do with you?"
Qin Hao squinted at Yang Benhong without giving him any face.
The movement here also attracted the attention of many people in the audience.
Seeing that Qin Hao was actually arguing with the disciples of Wanxiang Hall, there was an uproar around him.
"Bold, you are bold, do you know who I am?"
Yang Benhong was furious, took a step forward and glared at Qin Hao.
